title: PRESSER | Charlie Foster - Fall Ball Wrap-Up (11-16-26)
text: Yep. >> Um, how did your fall go? >> Um, I would say it went as as well as it could. Um, was in the zone a lot. Velo picked up a good bit and yeah. Um, can't complain at all. >> Velo picked up to what? >> I was up to 99 this fall. >> I thought I saw that at an instant. >> Yes sir. >> I thought I was seeing things. [laughter] >> But yeah, so it was it was >> how did you get that? Mangram or the strength program or >> I would say a little combination of both. Uh, last year I was pitching around like 210 lbs and then now I'm pitching around 225. And then obviously some mechanical adjustments from coach Mangram really really helped me there. So. >> How about your control when you ticked it up to 99? Were you still hitting the strike zone? >> Uh, yes sir. I think it was just my mentality of hey trying to throw everything over the center cut of the plate and let everything move that way and that like really changed my mentality of how I went about attacking hitters and it kept me in the zone a lot longer. >> Talk a little bit more about where you were to where you are now as far as location and how things have gone just a transition and getting adjusted here. >> Yeah. Um, obviously coming from the other side it was a little weird at first but uh you know I fell in love with coach Mangram on the phone in the transfer portal and I knew this was the place I needed to be and we [snorts] had a plan right away about my development and uh and so I couldn't have been more happier to be here and you know we've just done great things on the mound with like mechanical adjustments and that's just allowed me to be in the zone a lot longer. So. >> How have you been utilizing the ABS system if if at all this fall? >> Um, me as a pitcher I'll probably never use it. Um, I'm just going to let our catchers use that. Um, so I've never personally challenged a call but as long as they think they're confident in a pitch and they want to uh try to reverse a ball call I'll let them do that. >> Besides your heater, what's your good pitch? >> Um, I would say my uh like short cutter slider right now that uh generated a lot of width this fall and got a lot of swing and miss. So I would say that's my second one. >> What's the velo on that? 85 86? >> I was 88 to >> with it. >> Holy mackerel. >> Yeah. [laughter] So yeah. >> Okay. >> Yeah. Everything's ticked up a good bit. >> Yeah, that'll that'll do it. >> Yeah. Yes, sir. >> If you can tell it's first strike. >> Yes, sir. >> And do you have a a change up? I mean, you have a other pitches besides those two? >> Yes, sir. I throw a change up, sweeper and a curve ball alongside those two. So Yes, sir. >> much do you pay attention to the I guess saber metrics of it all and the kind of the deeper games I suppose? >> Um I'm not like I'm like 50/50. Like, you know, if, like, the metrics are good and, like, I'm not getting swing and miss or whatever, then hey, like, we need to go change something. But even if the metrics are, like, kind of iffy but I'm getting a lot of swing and miss, getting outs with it, then I'm just going to let it play out that way. >> All right, good. >> Yep.
